evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly from step 1 into logistics probing with no two-concerns discovery.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer at step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep gave only a single price range ($485–$679) with no mention of cheaper days or date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep stated 'we do not require any deposit or do we need any credit card information if you want to get this move scheduled?' but this is rate lock / no deposit phrasing without a plain ask for the business. Customer then asked to call back, and rep did not reassert the ask before accepting the callback.

top_strength: Jules gathered comprehensive logistics details (address, floor, walking distance, furniture list, box count, new address, floor level) and confirmed everything clearly, creating a solid move profile.
coaching_note: Step 2 is missing entirely — no two-concerns question was asked before probing started, and Step 3's two promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) were never delivered despite being the highest-impact trust-builder on the card; add those to your opening so the customer hears them before they worry.
